title.narrative: Harm Reduction for the Key/Vulnerable Populations and Resilient Sustainable System for Health

description.narrative: Mauritius - HIV - Ministry of Health and Wellness - MOH & W. This program has the following goals: To reverse the trend of the HIV Epidemic towards ending AIDS as a public heatlh threat by 2030. The objectives of this program are: Reduce by at least 25% new HIV infections among the Key Populations, adolescents and young persons, and the general population. Reduce by at least 50% the number of AIDS related deaths among persons living with HIV. Reduce Mother-To-Child Transmission of HIV to zero. Strengthen Resilient Sustainable Systems for Health (RSSH) and community system. Reduce structural and other barriers that hinder access to HIV and Harm Reduction Services
